question: At the exact functionmix midpoint and one common gradient/momentum state, is the deployed joint MLP step limited by local chart direction/capacity, only by update magnitude, by one matrix family, by both, or not at all relative to an uncompressed dense-Muon oracle?
authorization: One zero-persistent-update dense-oracle attribution only. No training run, coordinate increase, topology change, HyperConnection, residual change, learned basis, LoRA, MFU preflight, or larger rung is authorized by this plan.

protocol.exact_common_state: Use one backward pass and the exact persisted c_fc/c_proj Muon momentum states. Extract deployed singleton/joint steps by exact state restoration and compute uncompressed dense Muon targets before any disposable custom-optimizer step.
protocol.historical_oracle: Because this accepted trajectory used historical double-decay chart semantics, the primary dense oracle exactly applies the second endpoint decay after the canonical dense Muon update. Canonical single-decay dense Muon is a registered secondary control.
protocol.norm_controls: Scale each historical dense family globally to the deployed family Frobenius norm. Use these per-family norm-matched directions for the primary direction/capacity and family-attribution decisions.
protocol.heldout_validation: Score the frozen candidate set on 256 untouched paired validation batches. Estimate MLP/block-output recovery against the historical dense joint oracle on separate output windows.
protocol.exact_restore: Restore all BF16 materialized MLP tensors by exact copy around every candidate. Persist zero parameter or optimizer updates to the checkpoint.

decision_rule.reliable_improvement: Candidate-minus-reference 99% CI upper bound below zero and negative mean on every held-out window.
decision_rule.no_local_dense_gain: Historical dense joint does not reliably beat deployed joint; attribute the remaining loss to accumulated representation/path rather than the local step.
decision_rule.magnitude_only: Historical dense joint reliably beats deployed joint, but its per-family norm-matched version does not.
decision_rule.cfc_capacity: Norm-matched dense joint passes and norm-matched dense c_fc beats deployed c_fc both alone and when substituted into the deployed joint step.
decision_rule.cproj_capacity: Norm-matched dense joint passes and norm-matched dense c_proj beats deployed c_proj both alone and when substituted into the deployed joint step.
decision_rule.joint_only_capacity: Norm-matched dense joint passes but neither family passes its singleton-plus-hybrid attribution rule.
decision_rule.canonical_decay_control: Report canonical dense comparisons but do not override the primary historical-oracle classification.
decision_rule.architecture_gate: No result directly authorizes training, HyperConnection, residual-topology changes, or a learned dense basis.

execution.monitoring: direct foreground polling only; no watchdog, callback, queue worker, or heartbeat
